To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
broilers fed diets that contain corn from the Roundup Ready or YieldGard X Roundup Ready events performed as well as broilers fed non-transgenic control or commercial diets.
broilers fed diets based on NK603 corn, MON810 x NK603 corn or commercial reference corn performed similarly in terms of live weight gain, feed conversion and carcasses yield and composition.
broiler performance was not different (P < 05) when fed diets containing glyphosate-tolerent corn (Roundup Ready) or insect-protected and glyphosate-tolerable corn (YieldGarde x Roundup Ready).
In summary, our research is concerned with

the nutritional value of corn grain from the Roundup Ready corn event NK603 and the combined traits of the insect-protected corn MON 810 ( YieldGard com) event x glyphosate-tolerance corn NK603 event.

evaluating the nutritional value of Roundup Ready corn and YieldGard x YieldGard x Roudup Ready corn in broilers, and our results show that these corns have similar feeding values as their respective non-transgenics and commercial reference diets.

the evaluation of the nutritional value of corn grain produced from genetically modified corn plants that are tolerant to the herbicide glyphosate and/or contain the insecticidal protein of the bacterium Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) and the effects of such corn on the performance and carcass composition of broiler chickens.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the feeding value of the glyphosatetolerant corn events NK603 and MON 810 x NK603 was similar to that of their respective non-transgencic controls and commercial corn diets.

the feeding values of corn from the glyphosate-tolerance trait (NK603) and the combined insect-protected x glyphosate-tolerance traits (MON810 xNK603) are similar to those of the non-transgenic controls.
the nutritional value of Roundup Ready corn and YieldGard x YieldGard corn was equivalent to that of non-transgenic corn and commercial reference corn.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the nutritional quality of Roundup Ready corn is similar to the non-transgenic corn control and commercial corn diets.
the performance of broilers fed diets with the NK603 or the MON810 x NK603 corn events was comparable to the performance of those fed the respective non-transgenic and commercial control diets.
there is a strong body of evidence that transgenic corn is as nutritious as its non-transgenic counterparts.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there are no differences in performance or carcass characteristics of broilers when fed diets containing corn with transgenic events compared with non-transgenic corn or commercial corn diets.
the performance of broilers fed corn with the Roundup Ready and YieldGard x Roudup Ready traits were similar to that of their respective non-transgentic controls and commercial corn diets.
the nutritional value of corn containing the Roundup Ready and YieldGard xRoundup Ready traits is similar to that of their respective non-transgenics.
